name: Bulrush Natural Gas Production and Processing Facility

commitments.text:
1. Morrison must cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed, operated, dismantled and 
abandoned in accordance with the documents listed in Schedule A to this Certificate, collectively 
comprising Morrison.’s application.

2. Despite Condition 1 above, authorities required to give approvals, licences, permits or other 
authorizations under any other enactment to Morrison for the Project, may vary the design, construction, 
operation, dismantling and abandonment in accordance with that authority’s approval process, provided 
that the variation is not a project modification under the Environmental Assessment Reviewable Projects 
Regulation (BC Reg. 276/95), or a variation outlined in Condition 3 below. 
3. (a) If Morrison requires a variation outlined in respect of: 
(i) the acid gas reinjection scheme as proposed by Morrison and documented 
in Schedule A; or,
(ii) the location of the raw gas processing plant outside the boundary of the 
site as proposed by Morrison and documented in Schedule A;
Morrison must make an application for such variation to the Executive Director;
(b) The Executive Director, on receipt of the application referred to in Condition 3(a):
(i) may make a recommendation to the Minister and the Minister of Energy, 
Mines and Petroleum Resources as to a review process necessary for 
effective assessment of the potential effects of the variation proposed, and 
where the effects are potentially adverse, whether those effects may be 
mitigated;
(ii) on approval by the Minister and the Minister of Energy, Mines and 
Petroleum Resources as to the proposed review process, must establish that 
review process and cause it to be conducted; and,
(iii) on conclusion of the review process, must make a recommendation to 
the Minister and the Minister of Energy, Mines and Petroleum Resources 
regarding the variation.
(c) On receipt of the recommendation of the Executive Director, the Minister with the 
concurrence of the Minister of Energy, Mines and Petroleum Resources, may amend this 
Certificate.

5. Morrison must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started and constructed 
the Project within five years of the issue date of this Certificate.

7. Morrison must:
(a) prepare and submit written reports, to the satisfaction of the Director, Policy 
Development Branch, Ministry of Employment and Investment, on the progress of 
commitments made by Morrison in letters dated August 30, and November 2, 1995 to the 
Ministry of Employment and Investment with respect to hiring people resident in the area 
of the Project during construction and operation;
(b) include, subject to the provisions of the Freedom of Information and Protection and 
Privacy Act R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 61 the following matters in the reports referred to in

Condition 7 (a):
(i) the steps taken by Morrison to support hiring at the Project of people 
resident in or around the Peace River Regional District; and
(ii) statistics regarding the location of the residences of new employees;
(c) submit the reports referred to in Conditions 7 (a) and (b) starting no later than one 
month after the start of construction and bi-monthly thereafter until completion of 
construction, with a final report submitted within two months following the 
commencement of plant operations.

11. Morrison must comply with the requirements of the Fisheries Act (Canada) R.S.C. 1985, c. F-14, and 
obtain any and all authorizations deemed necessary by the Minister of Fisheries and Oceans.
